div.div:
Null-mutant phenotype "inviable", curated from published papers; one record per annotation, so a gene can carry several.
Includes conditionally inviable genes.
The annotation reports no medium or temperature; the loader assumes YEPD, solid, 30 °C.

div.div:
Colony size of each array strain on SGA selection medium, relative to wild type (fitness).
Four strain types: KanMX and NatMX deletions, DAmP, temperature-sensitive (TS) alleles.
Screens at 26 °C and 30 °C; deletion and DAmP values are temperature-combined (issue #410).
